create_gleu_scorer: create a GLEU scorer registered under the 'gleu' name for evaluating translation hypotheses
score_hypothesis_references: score a list of hypothesis strings against multiple reference lists using the GLEU metric
compute_sentence_gleu: compute per-sentence GLEU scores from tokenized hypothesis and reference strings
run_multiprocess_averaged_scoring: run multiprocess averaged scoring across sentences with a custom sentence-level score function
register_scorer_decorator: register a scorer class with VizSeq using the @register_scorer decorator with name and label
